usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.videos.characters.create(video=b"Example data", name="string")
print(result)

fields.name: video
fields.description: Video file used to create a character.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name for this API character.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) when the character was created.
